lines: Exhaustion assaulted me. My leg felt like it was about to tear off. And an infinite number of smaller wounds covered my body that all prevented me from running as I wanted.
It should be right there, but it still feels so far away...
I had thought that running through the mountains would be the safest, but if that masked woman also knew the areaー
Do you think you can escape from me?
Your reluctance to give up is a good quality for a Taimanin to have. But it's really over now.
This time, Saya did not regain consciousness. There was no way to escapeー
Suddenly, everything went white. And then a thunderous roar echoed.
A thunderbolt struck the Masked Madam directly and cut her clean in halfーbut her body instantly turned into a pile of leaves that then went up in flames.
Aww! Even though I hit you square on! That Ninja Art's so annoying!
I was stunned by the suddenness of their arrival, but Clear pulled me and Saya over to her to guard us with Kamuy, her protective shield.
Not really sure what happened, but... thanks, I guess?
Yukikaze for attack and Clear for defense. With that, our combat strength was suddenly even.
It doesn't matter how many of you kids show up.
The masked woman's aura turned menacing.
I'm normally not one to play with children, but I'll spend some time with you until dawn. Make sure to go home before your mom and dad wake up.
Who are you calling a kid!?
It was Asagi-sensei, the headmistress of Gosha Academy and the Almighty Taimanin.
(Not only Clear and Yukikaze, but even Headmistress Asagi!?)
Still, the masked woman seemed unfazed.
Igawa Asagi, you coming here speeds things up quite a bit. You know the agreement I have with the government, don't you?
(An agreement with the government!? ーIs that why she willingly shared so much information earlier?)
This is between those kids and me. They've taken on my request that they are now refusing to fulfill.
If you get involved, you will be the one to break the ceasefire agreement between us.
The masked woman's argument was quite legitimate.
It had been me who had broken the agreement and practically taken Saya NEO away in the first place, so Asagi-sensei had no reason at all to protect Saya.
And as the leader of the Taimanin, it would be much more important for her to not cause any conflict with this woman.
Silently praying for the best, I tried to gauge Asagi-sensei's reaction.
I'm so sorry to say this.
But this is already Gosha's territory, which means that girl is already a guest of Gosha.
If you lay hands on our guest, I believe it would be you who breaks the ceasefire?
Asagi-sensei smiled at me. I was so absorbed in trying to escape that I hadn't noticed, but I had already just barely made it into Gosha's territory.
(All thanks to the time that Saya bought us...)
So Yukikaze and Clear must have felt the presence of an intruder and came out here to defend the village.
The masked woman had lost her composure and silently glared at Asagi-sensei, but after a few moments, she lowered her weapons.
ーWe shall take our leave for today then. As for how to handle Saya NEO, I request a separate meeting at a later date.
The masked woman ordered the mercenaries and also turned to leave herself.
I will not forget this, boy.
She spoke with a somewhat amused smile on her face.
Asagi-sensei, thank you very much!! And you two also, Yukikaze, Clear!!
You brought back quite some trouble.
Looking worried, Clear peeked at the still unconscious Saya.
Ah, right! Asagi-sensei, we have to get her treated, quick...
Leave it to me. I've already contacted the rescue squad.
For some reason, Asagi-sensei looked at Saya somewhat nostalgically.
Asagi-sensei...? Uhm... do you know Saya?
Come to think of it, the masked woman had mentioned something like that; that Saya NEO was created based on a little girl. Did Asagi-sensei know her?
The rescue squad had arrived, and so I handed the girl over to them, her petite body shrouded in mysteries.
Shikanosuke!? You made it!!! I thought you'd been turned to charcoal!!
I mean, you fought against that Hestia! And plus you can only use that battery once.
Hehe, you won't believe what happened. I was rescued by an invisible person!
Hebiko had also caught up with us and was surprised to see Asagi-sensei and the others.
Hebiko! Thanks to you, we managed to escape. And you weren't even turned into sliced octopus!
How rude! Hebiko did get sliced up quite a bit though. But thanks to Fuma-chan, Hebiko was somehow able to make it.
Because you're so popular with the girls!
Then, out of nowhere, a faint smell of smokeー
Looks like you made it. At least my effort seems to have been worth it.
Rinka-senpai!!! Did you win against Asuka!?
We just had a fun little brawl, that's all.
She seems to like you, Fuma.
Again out of nowhere, another familiar voice.
How nice of you to see me all the way here. Oh, or did you want to see Fuma?
Wha-!? Don't be silly! Aahh, whatever!
The voice faded away into the sky above us. Beyond it, I could see Gosha Village being illuminated by the morning sunー
